name: Daivaradhane (Spirit Veneration)
description: Indigenous socio-spiritual system where territorial, heroic, and natural spirits are worshipped through hereditary mediums to ensure justice, health, and boundary protection.

name: Nagaradhane (Serpent Veneration)
description: Ancient ecological and spiritual worship of serpents through natural forest sanctuaries (Nagabanas), floor powder mandalas, and Vedic-Agamic rites.

name: Dvaita Vedanta Monasticism & Ashta Mathas
description: Rigorous dualistic theism founded by Sri Madhvacharya in the 13th century, administered via the rotational biennial Paryaya cycle of eight sovereign monasteries.

name: Syncretic Jain-Shaiva-Alupa Traditions
description: Harmonious institutional synthesis where Jain royal dynasties administered Shaiva sanctums and patronized both Tirthankara Basadis and folk Daivasthanas.

name: Harake Yakshagana Guilds
description: Institutionalized temple drama troupes (Melas) performing night-long mythological plays sponsored by devotees as solemn vows.

name: Aliyasantana Matrilineal Lineage & Oral Epics
description: Matrilineal inheritance system codified in folk memory through the oral epics of Siri and Abbaga-Daraga, governing property and ritual descent through sisters.
